env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The Retriever Agent utilizes the RAG technique [24] to efficiently fetch specific data from external resources provided by the user
env_context_strategy.note: Environment is user documents/internet; RAG retrieval is invoked by an agent via retriever_tool, retrieval method (embedding vs lexical) unspecified. Closest value.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Observation: The output is aligned with the input. Similarity score: 0.89.
observation_format.note: Observations are text in ReAct format; plots produced for user, not shown to be fed to model.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
Action: the action to take, should be one of {agent_tools}.
Action Input: the input to the action.
tool_call_format.note: ReAct text format (Action/Action Input) parsed from text; closest value json_in_text since no XML/native tools. Mismatch.

tool_count.note: Paper says Controller Agent has 'more than 140 tools' plus auxiliary tools; exact count not reported.

edit_primitive.note: Tools are control library functions; no file-editing tool listed in Fig. 5.

tool_schema_source.note: Tool descriptions 'provided through the tool functions'; mechanism unspecified.

loop_primitives.note: Planner then Controller (plan_execute); Critic feedback prompts Controller refinement (Sec. 3.1).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the Supervisor passes the query to the Planner Agent, which organizes the sequence of functions (or tools) that the Controller Agent will use
planning_granularity.note: Plan is an ordered tool list passed in messages; storage beyond messages unclear.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a supervisor LLM acts as the central decision-maker, orchestrating a network of specialized LLM agents

delegation_mechanism.note: Graph nodes pass shared message_list to next node.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:

human_in_loop.note: Human-in-the-loop tool used by Communicator for output format; closest value.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: If the answer is validated, it is stored efficiently by the Memory Agent for potential future use.
long_term_memory.note: Storage mechanism unspecified; stores whole conversations and recalls them.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Once an answer is generated, the Critic Agent, a trusted judge [29], reviews it to ensure alignment with the original user query.
self_verification.note: Critic uses similarity score threshold (App. B.3).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If the answer does not meet the necessary criteria, the Critic Agent provides feedback for improvement, prompting the Controller Agent to refine the response.

execution_isolation.note: Debugger has Python-REPL; isolation not described.
